paragraphs.text: Valerie Valdes is a writer from Miami, Florida, USA currently residing in Georgia, USA. She is co-editor of the award-winning Escape Pod science-fiction podcast, as well as the author of the Chilling Effect trilogy and space-fantasy novel Where Peace Is Lost . Her short fiction and poetry have appeared in Uncanny Magazine , Nightmare Magazine , and several anthologies.
Valdes contributed to the Magic Story for The Lost Caverns of Ixalan , episodes 1 through 6 Bloomburrow and Secrets of Strixhaven .
